productionEquivalentPath: the unmodified incumbent extractor, reached through src/fixtures/eval/eval-harness.ts runCaseArtifacts, which calls extractLabelEvidenceDetailed

pageSegModes.note: Every pass template in regions.ts sets pageSegMode SPARSE_TEXT (11). No template is altered by this sprint.

passPlanning.recoveryTriggers: needsBrandRecovery when the primary Brand state is NOT_OBSERVED; needsAlcoholRecovery likewise. Unchanged.
passPlanning.sellerRegionPass: planSellerRegionOcrPass is NOT exercised: sellerRegionTargets is empty in this acquisition, and its output never feeds the Brand observation in any case.

brandPath.optionalTreatmentNote: This opt-in entry point exists in field-selection.ts and is NOT called. DEFAULT_BRAND_SELECTION_OPTIONS.allowCoherentPlausibleLineMerge stays false.

generationTimeCapsInProduction.consequence: These are production behaviour, not evidence caps. Sub-span windows longer than 4 words are never FORMED, so acquisition cannot enumerate a candidate production never built. Whole-line candidates longer than 4 words ARE formed and then rejected with too-many-words, so those do appear. This boundary is recorded because it limits what any later counterfactual can claim about 'all candidate windows considered'.

haltConditions: a changed tesseract.js or tesseract.js-core version
a changed OEM or page-segmentation mode
a changed pass template, crop geometry or transform
any experimental flag or optional Brand treatment entry point being reachable
